verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's core value proposition is millisecond full-text search with typo tolerance, ranking rules, and zero-config indexing, all well documented and confirmed hands-on (probe-rt-2 shows a keyless local instance returning a typo-corrected result 'in milliseconds'). Community reports repeatedly praise raw search speed ('Blazing fast to search, at least 3x faster', 'searches are fast') even at scale (7M-80M documents), directly supporting instant, keystroke-level responsiveness. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a built-in debounce/as-you-type UI widget or client-side keystroke-search library, and some community reports note indexing lag on constantly-changing data which could affect real-time freshness under heavy write load.
